name: @busy-app/desktop-app
description: Antigravity BUSY Bar Electron Desktop Companion App
author: Antigravity

scripts.build: vite build --config vite.config.electron.ts && vite build --config vite.config.preload.ts && vite build
scripts.package:win: vite build --config vite.config.electron.ts && vite build --config vite.config.preload.ts && vite build && electron-builder --win
scripts.package:portable: vite build --config vite.config.electron.ts && vite build --config vite.config.preload.ts && vite build && electron-builder --win portable
scripts.package:installer: vite build --config vite.config.electron.ts && vite build --config vite.config.preload.ts && vite build && electron-builder --win nsis
